mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.1%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 650.0 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand for housing, which typically precedes a slowdown in overall economic activity and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 650.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a rise in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a supply shock that disrupts the economy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0 and RSAFS > 380000.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0%) signals a weak labor market, prompting the Federal Reserve to adopt accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 9.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 94.0 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically precedes a slowdown in economic growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 94.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY < 2.0%) signals a weak economy, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY < 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained growth in non-farm payroll employment above 130,000 thousand persons indicates a strengthening labor market, which typically supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 130000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in real GDP growth (GDPC1 QoQ growth < 1.5%) indicates a weakening economic expansion, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 QoQ growth < 1.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
